headline: 🔴 NetScaler zero-days patched, CISA orders feds to fix by Wednesday, 🎯 ShinyHunters web shells widen across PeopleSoft sectors, 💸 Operation Master turns GlobalProtect bypass into invoice fraud, 📦 Kiteworks lifts weekend shutdown with no CVE materialized, 🤖 CARBONATO botnet hijacks Hermes AI agent on exposed Docker
summary: Patched-but-exploited edge infrastructure dominated the day: Citrix confirmed and fixed its NetScaler zero-days under a federal deadline while KEV-listed PeopleSoft, GlobalProtect and TeamCity flaws fed web shells, invoice fraud and extortion campaigns. Researcher disclosures added a console named-pipe injection technique that evades EDR memory-write telemetry and an unsigned-JWT path into Microsoft's internal 17-trillion-row analytics service.
